preconditions.description: The length of the string s is between 2 and 300,000.
The string s has exactly n characters.

preconditions.expression: all(97 <= ord(c) <= 122 for c in s)
preconditions.description: Each character in s is a lowercase Latin letter.

postconditions.expression: output == 'NO' or (output == 'YES' and 1 <= l < r <= n)
postconditions.description: The output is either 'NO' or 'YES' followed by two indices l and r such that reversing the substring s[l:r] results in a lexicographically smaller string.

postconditions.expression: output == 'NO' or (output == 'YES' and any(s[l-1:r] < s[l-1:r][::-1] for l, r in possible_reversals))
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', then there exists at least one pair of indices (l, r) such that reversing the substring s[l-1:r] results in a lexicographically smaller string.
